selected_evidence.requirement: HTTPS on TCP 8443 returns secure-os-comparison-ready using a system-trusted certificate
selected_evidence.summary: Direct requests to 10.100.91.10:8443 returned HTTP 200 and the required body. curl used the system CA bundle, matched the certificate IP SAN, and reported certificate verification successful.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, observed new boot ID 0f9bd50f-9d72-4f5e-8ab5-b79dca0fc4ac, and proved httpd, firewall, listener, trusted TLS response, and page data recovered.
